title: </sub>  Keep unclear adjudications from closing the cohort
text:
</sub>  Keep unclear adjudications from closing the cohort

When every compared finding is assigned the existing `unclear` outcome, this definition treats the pull request as terminal merely because each finding has an outcome. The dependency contract explicitly defines `unclear` as requiring more human review (`docs/specs/developments/20260910143722_24-review-quality-benchmark-suite/1_24-review-quality-benchmark-suite_specs.md:253-265`), so ten unresolved pull requests could satisfy the cohort count and unlock measured or comparative claims. Enumerate the terminal outcomes and explicitly keep `unclear`/`unadjudicated` evidence from counting.
